gaps.why_now: Current master ships a bounded libfs helper lab for simple directory emptiness, negative-dentry lookup shaping, and offset-based directory planning.
Current master ships helper-only offset-based rename planning that keeps reserved dot-window and end-of-directory slots explicit without mutating live directory maps.

The libfs helper lab now models pure simple_transaction_get() transaction acquire planning, including the page-bounded write limit, zeroed page allocation, one-write-per-open staging, and explicit private-data handoff without claiming live readback, dentry mutation, or pseudo-filesystem state.

The libfs helper lab now models pure simple_transaction_release() cleanup planning, keeping page-backed private-data release, private-data clearing, and unconditional zero return explicit without claiming live file teardown or pseudo-filesystem lifetime ownership.

The libfs helper lab now models the pure simple_transaction_set() transaction publish planning path, including the response-size limit, the required private-data handoff, the publish barrier, and published response-size bookkeeping before any live readback or release state is claimed.

The libfs helper lab now models pure generic_check_addressable() planning, keeping sector and page-index window checks, zero-block short-circuiting, and explicit overflow status reporting visible without claiming live inode, buffer-head, or page-cache ownership.
A dedicated reviewability replay now keeps the current libfs helper surface explicit, including the landed addressability helper alongside the transaction and offset planners in fs/libfs.zig.
The libfs roadmap anchor needs one packet-local survey note that records the current helper-first filesystem boundary without widening into other Phase 13 workstreams.

Current master does not materialize the older shared Phase 13 build packet, so the libfs lane still relies on direct helper-local replays instead of claiming the missing wider build surface is present.
The current helper packet does not perform live dcache entry insertion, negative-dentry installation side effects, or dentry-map mutation; it stays at reviewable planning only.
The current helper packet does not drive live inode lifetime, inode lock ordering, or page-cache-backed filesystem state; it stays on helper-only directory, addressability, and transaction planning.
